'''Aelidas''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].
== History ==
After [[Mazrim Taim]] declared himself as a [[False Dragon]], Aelidas was selected as the head of the mission to capture and gentle him. Unbeknownst to her, the [[Black Ajah]] severely infiltrated the Red's delegation, and tried to use the opportunity to free Taim in the name of the Shadow.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
